# Did you deposit payroll taxes on time, and what is a late one costing you?

> Free payroll tax deposit calculator for small employers: monthly or semiweekly due dates, the $100,000 next-day rule, and the failure-to-deposit penalty with the cheapest way to apply your deposits. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
